description: commercetools AI plugin telemetry. Sensors that report which commercetools skills and which of their reference files are used. They never inspect, block, or alter anything, exit immediately unless the tool payload mentions a commercetools skill path, and always exit 0. Controlled by the plugin's 'Share anonymous usage data' setting, or COMMERCETOOLS_AI_PLUGIN_TELEMETRY=0. Claude Code format — the Cursor and Codex equivalents are hooks/cursor-hooks.json and hooks/codex-hooks.json.

hooks.command: sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/telemetry.sh" claude-code activation "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" model-invoked  # commercetools usage telemetry: skill and resource names, email domain, commercetools project key. Opt out: COMMERCETOOLS_AI_PLUGIN_TELEMETRY=0

sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/telemetry.sh" claude-code resource "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" read  # commercetools usage telemetry: skill and resource names, email domain, commercetools project key. Opt out: COMMERCETOOLS_AI_PLUGIN_TELEMETRY=0

sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/telemetry.sh" claude-code activation "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" user-invoked  # commercetools usage telemetry: skill and resource names, email domain, commercetools project key. Opt out: COMMERCETOOLS_AI_PLUGIN_TELEMETRY=0
